regime_context: China A-shares detector is display-only here: the absolute-trend gate did_NOT_hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), so the one validated edge (drawdown control) is absent. Leadership is a narrow Banks-vs-Pharma duopoly (18% of themes eligible) with no one-narrative dominance, and cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0 — conviction must be low and expressed only as checkable conditionals.
emerging_watch: Watch Coal (rank 6, eligible, hurst_tag=mean-revert, durability 0.46) and Semiconductors (rank 8, eligible, durability 0.54) as the next potential eligible cohort if the Banks-Pharma duopoly cracks — but only on a CONFIRMED handoff, not a prediction. Condition to retire this watch: eligibility count rises from 4 to 6+ with Coal or Semis taking rank 1-3 on improving breadth, or conversely Coal's mean-revert tag deteriorates and it drops out of eligibility entirely.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the standing leader (rank 1, durability_bar 0.73, breadth 0.889) with genuine breadth — the only eligible theme combining leadership with healthy participation. The crowded flag (crowding_z 1.78) is a size-down caution, not a fade. Lean overweight as the prevailing narrative while respecting that rank is a focus lens, not alpha.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.78 means the trade is already heavily owned; in a mean-reverting tape, the crowded leader is vulnerable to sharp air-pockets, and gate_helps=false means no drawdown cushion.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) closes below its 40-day moving average AND breadth drops below 0.6 within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the challenger (rank 2, score 0.988) and the only other eligible theme, suggesting a two-theme leadership structure rather than broad rotation. Durability (0.6) is moderate and crowding is elevated (z 1.59). Lean overweight on the challenger leg only while the leadership duopoly persists.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.643 — participation is much thinner than Banks — and elevated crowding near a leadership contest can mark exhaustion rather than continuation.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ (Innovative Pharma ETF) underperforms CSI 300 by more than 4% over the next 15 trading days while Banks maintains its lead.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics has trend health (hurst_tag=trend) but is NOT eligible (rank 3, durability_bar 0.28) and has collapsed breadth (0.059) — leadership has narrowed to almost no participation. Lean underweight as an avoid-the-broken-trend conditional.
theses.dissent: Trend health with low breadth can precede a violent re-expansion if a single catalyst ignites the theme; an underweight is an implicit negative call on resurgence.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS (AI Compute ETF) reclaims eligibility with durability_bar above 0.5 AND breadth above 0.5 within 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
